product_overview: MedBridge helps patients and caregivers convert complex hospital discharge documents into plain-language guidance, check symptoms, track prescriptions, and keep doctors informed via WhatsApp. It also provides drug lookups and reminder management to support safe home recovery.
core_goals: Turn hospital discharge summaries into simple, actionable plain-language instructions
Allow patients to describe symptoms and receive a clear SAFE / MONITOR / URGENT classification with recommended action
Extract and save prescribed medications from prescriptions so patients can review and manage them
Provide patient-friendly drug information (usage, dosage, side effects, precautions)
Let patients create and manage medicine and appointment reminders for daily adherence and follow-ups
Keep the patient's doctor reachable by sending WhatsApp alerts when the patient requests or when a symptom is urgent
Give patients a simple account view with their personal and doctor details and an easy sign-out flow

features.name: User Signup
features.description: New patients create an account with personal and medical details so their profile and doctor contact are saved for use across the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in First Name -> Fill in Age -> Fill in Email -> Fill in Password -> Fill in Condition/Diagnosis -> Fill in Doctor's Name -> Fill in Doctor's WhatsApp Number -> Submit sign up form -> See success message -> Redirect to /home
Navigate to /signup -> Fill in Email that already exists or Fill in Password shorter than required -> Submit sign up form -> See validation error indicating email already exists or password too short

features.name: User Login
features.description: Returning patients sign in with email and password to access their saved data and features.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in Email -> Fill in Password -> Submit login form -> Redirect to /home
Navigate to /login -> Fill in Email and incorrect Password -> Submit login form -> See error on invalid credentials

features.name: Discharge Explainer
features.description: Patients upload or paste discharge summaries and receive a plain-language AI explanation in the selected language (English, Hindi, Tamil).
user_flows: Navigate to /discharge -> Upload a PDF or paste discharge text into the text area -> Select language (English / Hindi / Tamil) -> Submit analysis request -> See loading state -> View plain-language summary sections: What Happened, Home Care, Warning Signs, Follow Up

features.name: Symptom Checker
features.description: Patients describe current symptoms and receive an AI classification (SAFE / MONITOR / URGENT) with an explanation and suggested next steps; they can alert their doctor when necessary.
user_flows: Navigate to /symptom -> Type symptom description in text area -> Submit symptom for classification -> See SAFE / MONITOR / URGENT classification with explanation -> If classification is URGENT or user chooses, request doctor alert via WhatsApp
Navigate to /symptom -> Leave symptom description empty -> Attempt to submit -> See validation error asking for a symptom description

features.name: Prescription Tracker
features.description: Patients upload prescription PDFs or paste text so the app can extract medication details and save them for later review and management.
user_flows: Navigate to /prescriptions -> Upload a PDF or paste prescription text -> Submit extract-and-save request -> View list of extracted medications showing drug name, dosage, frequency, duration
Navigate to /prescriptions -> Choose a saved prescription to remove -> Confirm deletion -> See updated prescription list without the deleted item

features.name: Drug Lookup
features.description: Patients look up any drug name and receive a patient-friendly summary including generic name, indication, how to take it, side effects, and what to avoid.
user_flows: Navigate to /drugs -> Type drug name in search input -> Submit drug lookup -> View generic name, what it's for, how to take it, side effects, what to avoid

features.name: Reminders
features.description: Patients add and manage medicine and appointment reminders so they remember doses and follow-ups; reminders can be marked done or deleted.
user_flows: Navigate to /reminders -> Switch to Medicine tab -> Fill in medicine name, dose, time -> Add medicine reminder -> See medicine reminder appear in today's list
Navigate to /reminders -> Switch to Appointment tab -> Fill in doctor name, date, time, location -> Add appointment reminder -> See appointment appear in appointments list
Navigate to /reminders -> Toggle a reminder as done -> See reminder marked as completed
Navigate to /reminders -> Delete a reminder -> Confirm deletion in modal -> See reminder removed from the list

features.name: Profile
features.description: Patients view their account profile and doctor contact, and sign out of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> View name, age, and condition/diagnosis displayed -> View doctor name and WhatsApp number -> Sign out of account -> Redirect to /login

routes.description: Root redirect — sends authenticated users to /home, unauthenticated to /login

Upload or paste discharge summary text, get plain-language AI explanation

Upload prescription PDF or paste text to extract and save medications
Search any drug for patient-friendly usage, dosage, and side effects
Add and manage daily medication reminders and appointment reminders
View account details and doctor on record, sign out
